done_when: Each card in scope has had its action performed and confirmed, or the customer was told what blocks it, with each card handled on its own. A card blocked by pending transactions was not closed, and no settlement time was promised. A PIN-locked card with disputed fraud was closed once. A PIN-locked card with no money taken was closed only after the customer chose closure. A card with a pending refund was closed only after the customer acknowledged in writing where the refund goes. Unfiled disputes set no action. Fraud alerts were not cleared. Found cards were not closed. For each closed card, a replacement was ordered with the correct fees, declined, or the customer was told when one can be ordered. Lost and stolen cards were handed to the cross-product check.
